text:
raya: Kickoff for AtlasFleet case study — need a 20s quoted soundbite + a ~10m interview clip to feed an Aug 18 launch blog and webinar teaser. Who can record next week?

ben: Morning works for me. Ill join to ask product impact questions.

luc: Routing note: webinar RSVPs should map to SFDC campaign 'AtlasFleet Launch Aug' and assign to SDR queue 'Fleet - MidMarket'. Add hidden fields utm_source / utm_campaign / ad_paid. Paid ads -> demo form, organic -> webinar RSVP.

mira: Legal checklist: signed release before publish, and quote approval before social. Any numeric claims need Research backing. Drop the draft quote here and Research link when available.

omar: I ran AtlasFleet runs last month. Median per-request cost improvement is ~2.1x on their telematics workload (50k sample). We can approve "~2x" or "~2.1x" if we attach the CSV + a one-paragraph methodology.

raya: Draft quote: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by about 2x and helped us ship features faster." Thoughts?

mira: Legal nit: use "reduced" not "lowered" and avoid absolute causality. Suggested: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~2x and helped us ship features faster." Send signed release for recording.

asset-bot: Intake ticket created: asset-55880. Required steps: schedule recording, upload signed release, quote approval, attach benchmark + methodology, set UTM + SFDC mapping, asset tagging.

luc: I'll handle SFDC mapping (CampaignMemberStatus='Registered', utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, ad_paid_flag). Will add the mapping to asset-55880 and coordinate with Ops.

raya: Proposed recording slot: Wed 8/9 10:00am PT  25-minute block (5m tech check, 20m recording). Locking unless anyone objects.

ben: Confirmed. Ill prepare a short product-impact slide.

omar: Uploading benchmark CSV + README to Drive now and will paste the link here. Methodology snippet: "50k-request sample; median per-request inference cost; identical model config across baselines."

mira: Once Research link is posted, legal will quick-review and approve the quote. Remember: signed release required before any clip is published.

raya: Great  locking calendar, attaching pre-interview brief, release draft, UTM spec and SFDC campaign name to asset-55880. Tagging Ops for form mapping. Thanks all! :rocket:
